0.reason: non-blocking check-strength or citation detail on a delivered figure that meets its numeric done-when (3.49:1 contrast, all 14 sections labelled); the ITER bank figure is redrawn when section 7 re-certifies the bank

findings.text: non-blocking: the COIL_LABELS line prints sections={len(coils)} labelled={len(coils)}, the same value on both sides, and detail_coils=0 is a hard-coded literal, so the check reported in the gate log can never show a missing label; only gate.py's SVG id count (itself a hard-coded 14) actually guards the labelling clause.

non-blocking: the label-over-data guard's collections branch, which is the one covering the coil polygons and the plasma mesh because draw_coils and draw_plasma_cells add collections (nova/media/poloidal.py:96 and :125), is never exercised by a negative control; control-data.log drives ax.plot and therefore fires only the lines branch at render.py:47-50, so the branch that matters for this figure is untested.

non-blocking: the label-clearance check runs only for text artists whose gid starts with 'direct-label', so a label added without that gid is silently unchecked while the save still reports labels_over_data=0, a fail-open over the very thing the check exists to catch.

non-blocking: the first wall is drawn #666666 (about 5.74:1 against white) and the coils #929292 (about 3.11:1), so the reference wall remains the figure's darkest mark at a higher contrast than the subject plasma mesh at 3.490750:1; the mesh reads as the clearest mark through its density, not through its contrast.

non-blocking: source.json carries 12 coil_names for 14 coil polygons, so two adjacent CS modules both read 'CS1' and the two VS3 sections both read 'VS3'; the labels faithfully copy the preparer's names but leave each pair indistinguishable to a reader of the figure they were added for.

non-blocking: the durable record names all_debug job 1315707 (gate-final.log at a31e87d5), while the committed-head gate that produced the committed SVG ran as job 1315718 (gate-committed.log at 6c7f62c), so the job id cited does not name the run behind the committed numbers.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against 8907e864; a31e87d5 rewrites the panel layout, style variant, coil labels and checked_save, and 6c7f62c makes the direct-label gids unique, refreshes the SVG and adds the landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when's three clauses are asserted: contrast 3.490750:1 on an independent ImageMagick raster, 14 direct-label element ids parsed from the SVG against a required 14, and ink 7.6017% against the 4.5% floor, all recorded in gate-committed.log at the head revision.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to redraw docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/iter-bank/iter-mesh.svg so the plasma mesh is the clearest mark; the rendered figure raises plasma contrast from 1.639551:1 to 3.490750:1 and labels all 14 coil sections, so the mesh is the visually dominant mark, though render.py:101 keeps the first wall darker still.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records both commits, the all_debug gate, the 3.490750:1 and 7.6017% measurements, the three control refusals, and states the suite fence was unarmed so no baseline/after pair ran.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the manifest's declared paths and the commit-by-commit diff; the four changed paths sit inside render.py, docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/iter-bank/ and the two fragment paths the manifest declares.

justifications.durability: No committed test reaches scripts/prototypes/iter_bank/render.py, and the only guards are the one-off gate.py assertions and the run-directory control logs, so nothing in the repository reddens if the contrast, the labelling or the label-clearance check regresses.
justifications.evidence: gate-committed.log records median plasma-outline contrast 3.490750:1 measured on a 1400x1073 ImageMagick raster at head 6c7f62c, with the retained 1.639551:1 defect reproduced by the gate's own base assertion.
justifications.fit: render.py:94-103 takes a DEFAULT_INK.variant and draws through the nova.media.poloidal painters as the neighbouring prototype drivers do, the added identifiers carry no plan or ticket label, and no lint finding is recorded.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The subject's median rendered contrast rises from 1.639551:1 to 3.490750:1 and every coil section is labelled in docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/iter-bank/iter-mesh.svg, though render.py:101 keeps the first wall darker than the subject.
justifications.reuse: The diff extends the existing local checked_save rather than adding a new definition, and no production save-with-check owner exists in nova/media; the search found prototype-local copies at scripts/prototypes/bank_fold_vertical/plot.py:34 and scripts/prototypes/iron_magnetisation/figures.py:40, which this file does not converge with.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every one of the four changed paths (render.py, iter-bank/iter-mesh.svg, iter-bank.html and the landing fragment) sits inside the declared write paths recorded in the manifest.
